title: Event-guided Person Re-Identification via Sparse-Dense Complementary Learning

datasets.name: ImageNet
datasets.anchor: initialization of our CNN encoder is ImageNet-pretrained

metrics.name: Rank-1
metrics.anchor: up to 3.4%, 4.7%, and 0.3% in terms of Rank-1 accuracy

notes: PRID-2011、iLIDS-VID、MARS为三个视频Re-ID主基准,退化条件(blurry/occluded)实验与消融也在PRID-2011/iLIDS-VID上进行;因无现成事件Re-ID数据集,事件流由display-camera系统与模拟器V2E从这三个数据集的帧生成,V2E为模拟器未计入数据集。ImageNet仅用于ResNet-50编码器的预训练初始化。mAP与Rank-1为原文缩写,文中未展开;另按4.4节计入模型复杂度度量Parameters与FLOPs。正文多处提及supplementary material,但本全文文件不含附录内容;相关工作里出现的数据集仅用于排除。
